name: Hercules A.T.C. 2006
summary: This EA is a trend-following system originally built for the Automated Trading Championship 2006, using moving average-based signals to identify and ride trends. It enters positions when trend indicators confirm directional momentum and manages trades with trailing stops. The strategy aims to capture sustained directional moves while limiting downside through protective stops.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个为2006年自动交易锦标赛设计的趋势跟踪系统，利用移动平均线信号来识别和跟随趋势。当趋势指标确认方向性动量时开仓，并通过追踪止损管理仓位。策略旨在捕捉持续的方向性行情，同时通过保护性止损限制下行风险。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于趋势跟踪原则，利用移动平均线的交叉或方向变化来识别趋势的形成和延续。入场条件通常依赖快慢均线的交叉信号或者价格与均线的相对位置关系来确认趋势方向，当短期均线上穿长期均线时做多，反之做空。出场条件包括固定止损、追踪止损以及趋势反转信号触发平仓，确保在趋势结束或判断错误时及时退出。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例分配方式，但没有复杂的动态仓位调整机制。资金管理方面，该EA使用止损来控制单笔风险，但由于是锦标赛版本，可能偏向激进风格以追求高收益。整体而言，策略逻辑相对简单直接，适合趋势明显的市场环境，但在震荡市中可能频繁产生虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is rooted in trend following principles, using moving average crossovers or directional changes to identify trend formation and continuation. Entry conditions typically rely on fast and slow moving average crossovers or the relative position of price to moving averages to confirm trend direction, going long when the short-term MA crosses above the long-term MA and vice versa. Exit conditions include fixed stop losses, trailing stops, and trade closure triggered by trend reversal signals, ensuring timely exits when trends end or signals prove incorrect. Position sizing employs fixed lot sizes or proportional allocation based on account balance, but lacks sophisticated dynamic position adjustment mechanisms. Money management incorporates stop losses to control per-trade risk, though as a championship version, it may lean toward aggressive styling to pursue high returns. Overall, the strategy logic is relatively straightforward and suitable for strongly trending markets, but may generate frequent false signals in choppy or range-bound conditions leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 趋势跟踪策略逻辑清晰简洁，易于理解和维护
使用追踪止损机制保护已有利润，降低回撤风险
锦标赛验证版本，经过实盘竞赛环境测试
参数可调性强，用户可根据不同品种和周期优化
pros_en: Clear and concise trend following logic that is easy to understand and maintain
Trailing stop mechanism protects existing profits and reduces drawdown risk
Championship-verified version tested in live competition environment
Highly adjustable parameters allow users to optimize for different instruments and timeframes
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中容易产生频繁虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏市场状态过滤器，无法自动识别趋势市和震荡市并切换策略
仓位管理较为简单，未采用动态仓位调整或风险比例控制
锦标赛版本可能偏向激进风格，不适合保守型实盘账户直接使用
cons_en: Trend following strategy prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in choppy/range-bound markets
Lacks market regime filter to automatically identify and adapt between trending and ranging conditions
Position sizing is simplistic without dynamic adjustment or risk-proportional control
Championship version may lean aggressive and is unsuitable for conservative live accounts without modification
improvements: 增加市场状态识别过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在震荡市中减少或暂停交易
引入动态仓位管理，基于账户风险比例和ATR自动调整手数
加入多时间框架确认机制，提高信号可靠性并减少虚假入场
improvements_en: Add a market regime identification filter (e.g., ADX or volatility indicator) to reduce or pause trading during ranging markets
Introduce dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lot size based on account risk ratio and ATR
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation mechanism to improve signal reliability and reduce false entries

risk_points: 缺乏市场状态过滤，震荡行情中可能连续开仓止损
锦标赛版本可能止损设置偏小以追求高收益，实际风险偏大
仓位管理未基于账户风险比例动态调整
risk_points_en: Lacks market regime filter, may consecutively open and stop out positions during ranging conditions
Championship version may use tight stop losses to pursue high returns, increasing actual risk
Position sizing not dynamically adjusted based on account risk proportions
